articles.title: A Dragonite Mail Carrier? This Sweet Pokémon Short Will Make You Smile
articles.summary: A girl named Hana follows a Dragonite who delivers mail and ends up on a heartwarming adventure to find a mystery letter’s owner. It’s a 15-minute animated short on YouTube, full of gorgeous flying scenes and tiny, magical details.

articles.title: These Tiny Binoculars Are Tougher Than Your Phone and Fit in Your Pocket
articles.summary: The Celestron Outland X 10x25 binoculars are small, waterproof, and weigh less than a smartphone. They’re perfect for a kid’s first nature adventure, but the view can look a little purple and blurry at the edges.

articles.title: From Taiwan to California: Teen Swimmer Janet Chen Is Chasing Big Dreams
articles.summary: Janet Chen, a World Junior Championships qualifier from Taiwan, will swim for Fresno State University in fall 2026. She’s a breaststroke and freestyle specialist who keeps smashing her personal best times.
